title: CLI panics when launched from a git worktree dir
body:
What version of Codex CLI is running? codex-cli 0.137.0
Steps to reproduce:
1. cd into a git worktree
2. run codex exec
Observed: panic on macOS.

title: MCP client failed to start: handshake failed
body: Version 0.140. The MCP client fails the handshake before capability exchange on startup.
